source_title: Tehseen Poonawalla joins Rise and Fall 2, says his arrival silenced Shehzad - India Today
source_excerpt:
Tehseen Poonawalla has entered Rise and Fall 2 as a wild card contestant. His arrival sets up a family contest with brother Shehzad Poonawalla.
Rise and Fall Season 2 is set for a family face-off as political commentator Tehseen Poonawalla enters the reality show as a wild card contestant. In a promo for the upcoming episode, host Virender Sehwag welcomes Tehseen with a cheeky remark about having two Poonawallas on the show, while Tehseen takes a dig at his brother, Shehzad Poonawalla, saying that his arrival silenced his ever-talkative brother.
In the promo, Sehwag introduces Tehseen by saying, " Aap ek Poonawalla ko jhel nahi paa rahe the. Main do karne wala hoon (You couldn't handle one Poonawalla. Now, I'm bringing in two)."
Tehseen then comments on the reaction to his arrival and says that most contestants were happy to see him, except one. Taking a dig at Shehzad, he says, "Shehzad kabhi bhi chup nahi hota hai, mere aane se yeh silent ho gaya (Shehzad is never quiet, but my arrival has silenced him)."
Sehwag further reveals that Shehzad believes only one Poonawalla will win the show. Responding to this, Tehseen confidently says, " Aur woh Poonawalla main hoon (And that Poonawalla is me)."
The promo hints at a possible clash between the brothers as Tehseen joins the competition. His arrival is expected to change the dynamics inside the house, particularly given Shehzad's apparent reaction to his entry.
Tehseen also reacted to the promo on X, where he shared it with a message for viewers. He wrote, "Who ever wins, a Poonawalla will always Rise & no one, no one should Fall !!!" Tehseen walked in acting like the boss, but Shehzad didn’t even flinch. That smirk on Shehzad's face said everything. Making big claims on stage is easy, but surviving Shehzad Poonawalla’s mind games and strategy inside the house is a whole different ballgame. He was replying to an X handle that shared the promo, which commented on the brothers' face-off, suggesting that Shehzad's reaction hinted at the competition to come.
Tehseen is a political commentator who previously participated in Bigg Boss 13 as a wild card contestant. His entry into Rise and Fall 2 brings him back to the reality television space, this time alongside his brother. When and where to watch Rise and Fall 2
Hosted by former Indian cricketer Virender Sehwag, Rise and Fall 2 premiered on September 26. New episodes stream daily at 12 pm IST on Prime Video and MX Player.
The show revolves around two groups of contestants: Rulers, who hold power, and Workers, who must compete to survive and work their way to the top. Through challenges, alliances, strategic moves and votes, contestants can change their positions in the game.
The second season features contestants including Gautam Gulati, Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Swara Bhasker, Karan Patel, Tej Pratap Yadav, Sara Gurpal, Niharika Tiwari, Siwet Tomar, Kaira Anu, Raj Grover, Irina Rudakova, Manish Kashyap, Kajal Raghwani and Anish Bhagat.
With Tehseen now joining the competition, viewers will be watching to see how the brothers navigate the game and whether their rivalry spills over into the challenges ahead. - Ends
